references.text: The context for the priest's examination of skin diseases is established in the previous verse
Continues the description of the priest's examination of white spots on the skin
Same examination procedure: the priest looks at the sore, white hair, and whether it goes deeper than the skin
The priest examines the sore and declares the person unclean - same procedure as in verse 3
The priest declares the person unclean due to leprosy, same conclusion as in verse 3
The priest examines the leper to see if the disease has been healed - opposite of the uncleanness diagnosis in 13:3
Reference to following the priests' instructions regarding leprosy
Jesus heals a leper and sends him to the priest to show himself, in accordance with the Mosaic Law
Jesus sends the ten lepers to the priests to be examined, according to the regulations in Leviticus
